property_summary: After any sequence of calls that includes a fallback call with exactly 10 ether, the current block timestamp should be strictly greater than the pastBlockTime.
After any call to the contract, the pastBlockTime state variable is always equal to the block timestamp of the call, unless the call was reverted.
After a successful fallback call with 10 ether, if block.number % 15 == 0, the contract's balance drops to zero by the end of the transaction.
After a successful fallback call with msg.value == 10 ether, pastBlockTime is set to block.timestamp of that call.
After a successful fallback call (msg.value == 10 ether), the contract's balance decreases by exactly msg.value (10 ether) when block.number % 15 == 0.

After a successful non-reverting fallback call with msg.value exactly 10 ether, the contract's balance either remains unchanged or decreases by the sent amount (10 ether) depending on whether the transfer condition (block.number % 15 == 0) is met.
after a successful fallback with exactly 10 ether, if block number modulo 15 is zero, contract balance becomes zero; otherwise balance increases by 10 ether

The contract's balance after a fallback call with exactly 10 ether is always at least 10 ether, because the reference version only transfers the full balance when block.number % 15 == 0, otherwise the balance increases by 10.

After any number of fallback calls each with exactly 10 ether, the final contract balance must be congruent to (10 * (number of fallbacks not on a block where block.number % 15 == 0)) modulo 10 ether plus any transfers on block.number % 15 == 0.
After a successful fallback call with exactly 10 ether, the contract's pastBlockTime increases if the call succeeds.

After a fallback call, the contract's balance is always at least the amount of ether sent in that call, because the original transfers only the entire balance on certain blocks but never sends any ether out of the contract otherwise.
After any call to fallback, the contract balance is never empty when block.number % 15 == 0.
The contract balance does not change when block.number % 15 == 0 after a fallback call with 10 ether and valid timestamp.
